newsitem.title: DENMARK: Two said to be killed in Danish biker gang blast.
newsitem.headline: Two said to be killed in Danish biker gang blast.

text.p: A blast hit the Hell's Angels biker gang's central Copenhagen base on Sunday and a hospital source said two people had been killed and at least five injured in what appeared to be the latest blow in a Nordic biker war.
The Danish news agency Ritzau said the explosion may have been caused by a missile, but there was no immediate police comment.
The most likely attacker was the rival Bandidos gang, which has waged a bloody turf war against the Hell's Angels for three years.

But security officials have feared of late that a rising tide of public resentment against the gangs and their gunfights and bombing raids in residential neighbourhoods could lead to some kind of vigilante action.

Copenhagen city council has been trying for weeks to force the Hell's Angels from their fortified clubhouse on Titangade, near apartments and a hospital, and residents near another Hell's Angels property in the city have held street protests demanding their eviction.
A law allowing police to throw the gangs out of residential areas had its first parliamentary reading on Friday and the government has pledged that it will be law by the end of the coming week.
